title: Slot facts, branch overlays and node observations invalidate an open workspace
description: ADR-071 fleet migration writer proof. Run from the repository root against an isolated authenticated one-slot gateway and Command Center over CDP. Set FARMSLOT_OFFLINE_PROOF=1, FARMSLOT_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATION=1, FARMSLOT_HOME, FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE, GATEWAY_PORT, FARMSLOT_PROJECTS_DIR, FARMSLOT_UI_URL, FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT and FARMSLOT_RUN_WEB_EVIDENCE_DIR. FARMSLOT_SLOT_RESOURCE_PROOF names a setup receipt with home, poolFile, slotId and repo. The pool must be inside the selected home's pool directory, the slot must start in custom mode, and the gateway must contain no runs. A second client changes only that slot's mode through config.slot.update; the helper verifies its actual canonical slot context refetches without Refresh, then restores the exact pool bytes. Use an existing terminal server; the fixture lifecycle must close only its own slot session. No devices or workers are launched and no UI values are injected. This does not claim whole fleet migration or offline fleet persistence. Set FARMSLOT_BRANCH_WATCHERS=1. After the mode changes, the helper switches branches in the disposable worker repository and restores its original branch, commit and clean state. The real branch watcher must advance the same canonical slot query and render the branch in Slot Info. Task-progress and PR-health setters share the overlay path; this recipe does not claim live task/PR collector acceptance. A private node-subject peer authenticates through the actual gateway, registers the fixture machine, sends a defined metrics observation and disconnects. It explicitly refuses machine commands, launches no daemon or hardware collector, and retires its issued credential/principal. Node/pressure/slot notices must accompany canonical slot refetches and current gateway health/host-load reads. This proves node observation handling, not hardware metric collection. The setup receipt must name a resourceId declared in the owned slot/project. Defined node.resource.changed observations switch its status running/stopped/running and node disconnect clears it to unknown. Actual fleet.status reads must show coherent/none/coherent/none while the same canonical browser query covers each newer slot revision. No resource command or hardware probe runs. Finally an external writer changes only checked_at in the isolated status file. The actual filesystem observer must publish enriched fleet facts and the open browser row must retain coherent resources; the touched status bytes/permissions restore before cleanup. No worker lock or run field is modified. Set FARMSLOT_MONITOR_FLEET_POLL_MS=600000 in the isolated stack so a periodic reread cannot mask a broken filesystem-observer callback during the bounded proof.

proofTargets.claim: A committed mode change from a second real client publishes its slot key while leaving unchanged run bindings alone.
The open production slot workspace refetches its same canonical query to cover the newer slot revision without Refresh.
A real branch change and restoration advance slot revisions, refetch the same canonical slot query and render the branch without Refresh or unrelated run notices.

An authenticated node connection, defined metrics observation and disconnect publish node, pressure and slot keys, refetch the same canonical browser query and expose current health and host load through fleet.status.
Defined resource observations and node disconnect notify slot/fleet keys, refetch the same canonical browser query and expose current fleet coherence without changing run bindings.
A real external status-file observation delivers current derived fleet facts to the actual client instead of the un-enriched base snapshot.

prove.intent: Change only the owned slot mode, verify gateway notices and the actual canonical workspace, and restore the pool.

notice.intent: Require real slot notifications and no unrelated run-binding invalidation.

context.intent: Require the same current query to cover the newer slot revision in both mode transitions.

branch.intent: Require the real branch watcher and the same canonical slot query to cover both branch transitions.

node.intent: Require real authenticated node events, canonical browser refetches and gateway health/host-load reads, with no run-binding notifications.

resource.intent: Require resource observations and disconnect clearing to update canonical query revisions and current fleet coherence through real node/client endpoints.

watcher.intent: Require the real filesystem observer and production browser row to retain derived resource coherence, then restore the external status-file update.
